kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller
jq result for finding count is used directly in arithmetic comparisons without error checking; if jq fails, empty n breaks loop control and produces unclear error messages.
jq result for accumulated proposal links is not checked for failure; if jq fails mid-loop, links becomes corrupted and reports incorrect proposalLinks to caller.
